name: Field of Battle
desc:
Field of Battle is a medieval fantasy combat game where Humans and Orcs clash in epic battles to emerge victorious throughout the realms. Fight alongside players and NPCs to slay your foes in many fierce battles while you advance your character, forge legendary gear, and master your skills to become an epic champion. Join and begin your quest to rise to the top as the most powerful warrior!

Official FOB Group: https://www.roblox.com/groups/group.aspx?gid=2982086

scripts.title: Most Efficient Auto Farm
scripts.features:
I am the original creator of this script (https://v3rmillion.net/member.php?action=profile&uid=750043). Another user posted the script giving me credit, but they posted an outdated version.

NOTE: This script will only work properly in a VIP server. Using it outside a VIP server will result in you being reported and quickly banned.


-  Only public WORKING autofarm for Field of Battle that currently exists
- Supports separate weapons for killing NPCs, and for killing the general
- Supports webhook logging with hourly rates and so on
- Has a failsafe that will disable the script whenever a player joins, and re-enable it when they leave
- It supports auto map-voting so you can automatically vote for a map, e.g. Savannah
- Supports disabling rendering to farm on multiple accounts at once
- Has an auto shutdown timer to not look suspicious
- Has an Ignore Players feature so you can autofarm on two accounts at once in the same VIP server
- Has an attack Neutral NPCs feature
- Option to use your 'BossWeapon' on regular NPCs, such as mages and archers.
- Consistent feature updates and bug fixes.

Join my Discord at dsc.gg/amiriki to see new updates, or to report bugs/suggest features!
scripts.script:
--[[
Update 22/08/2023
- Fixed teleporting bug
- Fixed Discord webhook not being sent
- Added a feature to attack Neutral NPCs too, such as the Dragon on Volcano
- Added a feature to use your 'BossWeapon' (General Weapon) on other NPCs. Use this on mages or archers, as they're spread out so an axe likely would be less efficient
--]]

getgenv().FOFConfig = {
    ['AutofarmEnabled'] = true,
    ['NPCWeapon'] = 'Battle Cleaver', -- The name of the weapon that you want to use to clear the NPCs. An axe is recommended.
    ['BossWeapon'] = 'Greatsword of Flying II', -- The name of the weapon that will be used to kill the general once the other enemies are dead.
    ['WebhookURL'] = '',
    ['DisableOnJoin'] = true, -- Whether you want the script to automatically disable itself if someone joins the server.
    ['EnableOnLeave'] = true, -- Whether you want the script to automatically restart when you are the only person in the server.
    ['IgnorePlayers'] = false, -- Whether the script should ignore players on the enemy team. This is useful for farming on two accounts at once.
    ['Map'] = 'Savannah', -- Which map the script should vote for.
    ['DisableRendering'] = false, -- Whether you want to disable rendering.
    ['AutoShutdownTimer'] = 6, -- How long the script should autofarm in hours before shutting down in order to seem legit. Set it to 0 to not automatically shutdown.
    ['AttackNeutralNPCs'] = true, -- Whether the script should attack Neutral NPCs, e.g. Rogues
    ['UseGeneralWeaponNPCs'] = {["mage"] = true, ["archer"] = true}, -- What enemies (aside from the General) the script should use your General-killing weapon on. This is useful for spread out enemies like mages and archers.
	['DebugMode'] = true -- Whether the script should output debug information in chat
}

loadstring(game:HttpGet('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Amiriki/FOF/main/script.lua'))()
